answers.core: It touches the native AnimatedSprite2D and the feature is analog to AnimationPlayer Reset on Save, already implemented in the engine.
answers.workaround:
If you're playing via script, you can `stop()` before `play()`.

If you're using AutoPlay, better click the Stop button or set frame to 0 directly in the inspector.

title: Implement Reset on Save (to first frame) for AnimatedSprite2D (similarly to AnimationPlayer)
